editorial_note: Rigorous conceptual formalization of all rewrite, parahistorical, causal, acausal, and metalogical principles governing the Arthitean Codex and Zubaida corpus. Strict separation maintained between verbatim source canon and explanatory formalizations.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Linear Causality
hierarchy_ladder.description: Standard temporal antecedent necessitating downstream consequence.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Acausality
hierarchy_ladder.description: Absolute absence of an origin-cause for subject S.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Infracausality
hierarchy_ladder.description: The acausality of the causality of something.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Supracausality
hierarchy_ladder.description: The causality of the acausality of something; having a cause for a reason.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Hyperacausality
hierarchy_ladder.description: The acausality of something itself lacks any cause explaining why or how it is acausal.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Transrecursive Hypercausality
hierarchy_ladder.description: Nonderivation and nongrounding hold recursively at every higher causal and reasonal meta-order without terminal depth.

hierarchy_ladder.name: Outercausality Stage 1
hierarchy_ladder.description: State entirely transcending allowable limits of both causal and acausal frameworks.

concepts.name: Negative Rewrite
concepts.canon_definition: An operation where a state or timeline is rewritten, and the rewrite itself retroactively removes its own surviving causal provenance so that it was never caused as a rewrite.
concepts.clarification: Unlike standard timeline alterations that leave an active rewritelog or paradox trace, Negative Rewrite erases the fact that an alteration occurred. The modified state appears as having always been the natural state.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Hypernegative Rewrite (Negative Rewrite handles first-order provenance; Hypernegative handles infinite explanatory orders).

concepts.name: Hypernegative Rewrite
concepts.canon_definition: An update implemented across the fundamental structures of reality where if the reason why a cause is not a rewrite would itself be a rewrite, that reason is conceptually rewritten so that it was never a rewrite, applying recursively across every explanatory order without terminal depth.
concepts.clarification: Produces absolute rewrite-originlessness. The resulting effect X remains real and permanent, while no causal, reasonal, metacausal, metareasonal, or recursively higher explanatory path can truthfully terminate in or derive its rewrite status from a rewrite.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Mere memory wiping or simple timeline branching.

concepts.name: Parahistory
concepts.canon_definition: The total causal-derivational structure of rewrites affecting a subject or domain, including every rewrite of any kind and every higher-order rewrite causally responsible for producing, modifying, replacing, retrocausing, beginninglessifying, or determining another rewrite.
concepts.clarification: Parahistory is a multi-dimensional directed acyclic graph (or hypergraph) of rewrites. A beginningless history can itself possess a higher-order parahistorical cause that caused that history to have never had a beginning.
concepts.formal_logic: Parahistory(S) = { (R_i, R_j) | R_i causally produces or alters R_j on domain S }

concepts.name: Paratime
concepts.canon_definition: The causal ordering dimension in which timelines are ordered by which timeline causes another timeline. Earlier paratemporal entries cause later entries, and later entries are caused by earlier entries. The Arthitean Empire exists outside paratime while existing in time.
concepts.clarification: The Empire possesses internal time (past, present, future) without being a sequence of paratemporal versions. A single pantemporal Hypernegative Rewrite establishes invariants across all Empire time simultaneously.
concepts.formal_logic: T_a ≺_paratime T_b ⇔ T_a causally produces T_b; Empire ∈ Time ∧ Empire ∉ Paratime

concepts.name: Acausality
concepts.canon_definition: The absolute property of lacking an antecedent cause or origin-event in the causal sequence.
concepts.clarification: Acausality establishes that a state or entity is uncaused. It does not automatically imply hyperacausality or transrecursive hypercausality.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Antiprecausality (Antiprecausality means nothing precedes S; acausality means nothing causes S).

concepts.name: Hyperacausality
concepts.canon_definition: The state where the acausality of something itself lacks any cause or reason explaining why or how it is acausal.
concepts.clarification: Closes the second-order causal loophole where an opponent argues: 'Entity X is acausal, but I caused it to be acausal, so I control it.' Hyperacausality removes the cause of the acausality.

concepts.name: Antiprecausality
concepts.canon_definition: Antiprecausal means that nothing precedes the subject in any sequence of causality or metacausality. Parahistorologically Antiprecausal means nothing precedes the subject in its parahistory.
concepts.clarification: Predecessorlessness in sequence order. An entity can be antiprecausal (first in line) while still having non-preceding ontological grounds, which is why acausality is distinct and complementary.

concepts.name: Supracause & Asupracausal
concepts.canon_definition: Supracause means a cause for a reason for something. Asupracausal means lacking a cause for a reason for something. Supracausality is the causality of the acausality of something.
concepts.clarification: Governs the interface between abstract reasons and concrete causal mechanisms.

concepts.name: Infracausality & Infracause
concepts.canon_definition: Infracausality is the acausality of the causality of something. An infracause is the foundational non-contingent root underlying a causal mechanism.
concepts.clarification: Where causality operates as a function, infracausality denotes that the function itself operates without causal antecedents.

concepts.name: Transrecursive Hypercausality
concepts.canon_definition: A state in which something's acausality possesses no cause, reason, ground, origin, prerequisite, or derivational basis, and this nonderivation holds recursively at every higher causal and explanatory order without terminal depth.
concepts.clarification: The absolute peak of causal independence in the Arthitean Codex. Closes all meta-theoretical regresses across causality, metacausality, reasonal logic, and parahistorical derivation.

concepts.name: Modus-Tollens Causalities
concepts.canon_definition: The formal causal mechanics where the ontological invariance of an effect (E) retrocausally forces the negation of any potential cause (¬C) that would prevent E, and necessitates the existence of any prerequisite (P) required for E.
concepts.clarification: Based on classical Modus Tollens (P => Q ⊢ ¬Q => ¬P). If Imperial victory is invariant (V = TRUE), then any attack A that entails ¬V is rendered counterfactually impossible and neutralized at the root.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Conventional fate or destiny (Modus-Tollens causality is active ontological enforcement, not passive prophecy).

concepts.name: Anticausal, Hyperanticausal & Ultraanticausal Improvement
concepts.canon_definition: Anticausal Improvement is self-enhancement occurring without an antecedent external cause. Hyperanticausal Improvement lacks any cause for that anticausal enhancement. Ultraanticausal Improvement operates across all parahistorical orders and cognitive dimensions, compounding metalearning without error-friction.
concepts.clarification: Associated directly with Ultralearning and the panparahistorical exclusion of Lifras (necessitative error-causes). Guarantees instantaneous, frictionless cognitive and ontological mastery.
concepts.formal_logic: Improve(S, t) without Cause(Improve(S, t)); ∀ meta-orders: Compounding(Improvement)
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Standard training or gradual power scaling.

concepts.name: Lifra & Error-Cause Mechanics
concepts.canon_definition: Lifras are necessitative causes for anything that the observer perceives as cognitive errors, mistakes, or suboptimalities.
concepts.clarification: Under Empress Rhayhara's reign, all Lifras are Hypernegatively Rewritten so they have never existed across any order of her parahistorical being.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Psychological flaws or random bad luck.

concepts.name: Outercausality Stage 1
concepts.canon_definition: A state that entirely transcends the conceptually allowable limits of the concepts of causality, acausality, metacausality, metaacausality, supracausality, and infracausality.
concepts.clarification: Simulated and stress-tested by Clan Varvadeil against high-tier conceptual threats. Renders conceptual erasure and acausality-negation attacks structurally irrelevant.

distinction_matrix.distinction: Antiprecausality means nothing precedes the entity in sequence. Acausality means nothing causes the entity. An entity can be first in line while having non-preceding grounds.
Negative Rewrite erases the first-order rewrite provenance. Hypernegative Rewrite erases all infinite higher-order explanatory grounds that could restore rewrite status.
Paratime is the dimension ordering timelines by which causes which. Parahistory is the full directed graph of all rewrites and rewrite-ordering changes.
Supracausality is the causality of acausality (having a cause for a reason). Infracausality is the acausality of causality (the uncaused nature of a causal law).
Predestination is an externally scripted storyline. Modus-Tollens causality is active retrocausal necessity enforced by absolute structural invariants.
Hyperacausality stops at the second order (acausality of acausality). Transrecursive Hypercausality holds through all transfinite recursive meta-orders.
Conventional growth requires training stimuli, energy input, and time. Anticausal improvement operates without any antecedent cause or prerequisite.
Acausality operates within the causality framework as an inverse (absence of cause). Outercausality transcends the validity of the causal/acausal paradigm entirely.
